verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published TFLOPS or TOPS figures for the MI355X with precision and sparsity stated. The only performance claim is a relative marketing multiple ('up to 2.2X the AI performance'), which is exactly the bare number the story rejects. The datatype list (MXFP6/MXFP4) and community per-clock comparisons give no absolute throughput figures, and the vendor product page was not crawlable, so any spec table there is unevidenced.
